metadata.name: pop_market
metadata.description: POP / Proof of Pain price-bin market: fee-funded nonwithdrawable liquidity at fixed price bins

instructions.name: activate_market
docs: Fund seed quote, verify supply and authorities, revoke mint authority, activate. All
checks fail atomically.

instructions.name: claim_fees
docs: Claim protocol (kind 0) or creator (kind 1) revenue in the fee vault's mint to the
published recipient. Permissionless crank; the destination owner is enforced.

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Create a market and its fixed-supply mint. Mints exactly `seed_base` into the locked base
vault. Mint authority stays with the market PDA until activation (to allow genesis
vesting allocations) and is then revoked. No freeze authority is ever set.

instructions.name: create_vesting
docs: Genesis-only published vesting allocation (founder / ecosystem). Mints into an on-chain
vesting vault before activation. Bounded by `max_genesis_allocation_bps` of total supply.

instructions.name: evaluate_graduation
docs: Permissionless re-evaluation from stored counters (normally graduation happens inside matching).

instructions.name: execute_pop_buyback
docs: Manual, authority-approved buyback with explicit bounds: spend realized WSOL on the POP
market (scar fee charged into INELIGIBLE escrow, no protocol/creator fee) and burn the
purchased POP atomically. Remaining accounts: bin pages.

instructions.name: initialize_bin_page
docs: Permissionless lazy page creation: assigns the fixed seed schedule exactly once.

instructions.name: match_bins
docs: Permissionless, bounded: attempt matching on every bin of one page.

instructions.name: swap_exact_in
docs: Exact-input, fill-or-kill swap. Remaining accounts: the bin pages the route may touch,
in traversal order (cursor page first).

instructions.name: sweep_buyback_funds
docs: Permissionless: move the buyback earmark (non-POP markets only) to the buyback vault.

errors.name: PriceTooSmall
errors.msg: Reference price too small to represent (p0_x64 < 2^32)

errors.name: PriceRange
errors.msg: Price table overflow or zero price at range extreme

errors.name: MarketNotCreated
errors.msg: Market is not in the created state

errors.name: ZeroTradable
errors.msg: Tradable input is zero after fees

errors.name: TraversalLimit
errors.msg: Traversal limit reached before input was filled

errors.name: BuyInventoryExhausted
errors.msg: Buy-side token inventory exhausted at the range limit

errors.name: SellInventoryExhausted
errors.msg: Sell-side quote inventory exhausted at the range limit

errors.name: PageNotProvided
errors.msg: Required bin page account was not provided

errors.name: InvalidPage
errors.msg: Bin page does not belong to this market or has an invalid address

errors.name: InvalidQuoteMint
errors.msg: Quote mint must be canonical wrapped SOL

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: Invalid token account owner or mint

errors.name: TokenAccountDelegated
errors.msg: Token account has a delegate or close authority; rejected

errors.name: MintAuthorityPresent
errors.msg: Mint has an authority that must be absent

errors.name: SupplyMismatch
errors.msg: Mint supply does not equal the committed allocation

errors.name: VestingNotAllowed
errors.msg: Only the genesis POP market may carry vesting allocations

errors.name: BuybackSpendCap
errors.msg: Buyback spend exceeds cap or realized funds

errors.name: NotPopMarket
errors.msg: Market is not the POP market

types.name: FactorySettings
docs: Factory defaults applied to markets created under this config version.

fields.name: max_genesis_allocation_bps
docs: Max share of total supply that genesis vesting allocations may take (bps of total).

fields.name: allocated_supply
docs: Supply minted to vesting allocations (genesis only).

fields.name: band_hardened_bits
docs: Bit i set when band (min_band + i) has crossed the band target.

fields.name: start_offset
docs: Offsets in seconds relative to the market's activation timestamp.
